purpose: Review a finite customer-experience, product/service-quality and retention KPI domain before opening source rows, document text, quality values, candidate values, comparators, prices or returns.

repository_evidence.incident_boundary: Product recalls, operational interruptions, safety incidents and enforcement outcomes are Campaign166 or earlier event families and cannot be relabeled as recurring quality KPIs.
repository_evidence.operating_scale_boundary: Customer counts and active-user scale were reviewed in Campaign168; retention, churn and repeat behavior require their own point-in-time numerator and denominator rather than a post-hoc count transform.
repository_evidence.domain_distinction: Returns, defects, complaints and retention are recurring outcome rates rather than one-off incidents or security-price transforms, but no complete local point-in-time contract admits them.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact official filing, issuer report, regulator complaint dataset or audited service-quality source with immutable bytes and observation identifier
first public timestamp, reporting period, revision, restatement, withdrawal and trading-session availability
issuer, listed security, subsidiary, brand, geography, channel, customer class, product and service mapping without current-state leakage
taxonomy separating returns, refunds, warranty claims, repairs, defects, failures, scrap, rework, yield, complaints, satisfaction, retention, churn, renewal and repeat purchase
numerator, eligible-population denominator, cohort, exposure period, sold-versus-shipped basis and gross-versus-net event semantics
voluntary service action, mandatory recall, regulator complaint, litigation claim and routine warranty distinction
severity, duplicate case, reopened case, resolved case, partial refund, replacement, goodwill and no-fault return semantics
customer cohort entry, exit, pause, reactivation, contract renewal, subscription downgrade and product migration rules
industry comparability and deterministic exclusions for incompatible products, service cycles or complaint regimes
missing, undisclosed, unknown, not-applicable, true zero and suppressed-small-count semantics without favorable absence coding
complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full-market denominator, delisting coverage, pagination and one-shot acceptance gates
parser, identity, timing, denominator and source-acceptance tests using no candidate, comparator, price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: product_return_refund_warranty_claim_or_service_cost_rate
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A historically published rate of customer returns, refunds, warranty claims, repairs or related service cost against an eligible installed or sold base.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted source freezes numerator, sold/installed denominator, voluntary versus mandatory action, product cohort, severity, period, first availability, revisions and full 2019-2023 coverage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: defect_failure_yield_rework_or_scrap_rate_disclosure
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A recurring operating-quality measure of conforming output, failures, rework or scrap.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Inspection stage, unit, production denominator, internal/external failure, product mix, plant scope, restatement, first-public time and comparable history are not frozen.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: customer_complaint_resolution_or_satisfaction_metric
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A historically published measure of complaints, service resolution, satisfaction or recommendation for a defined customer population.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Survey frame, regulator versus issuer complaint channel, duplicate and resolved-case rules, response bias, denominator, first-public timestamp and complete coverage lack an accepted contract.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: customer_retention_churn_renewal_or_repeat_purchase_rate
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A historically published cohort outcome describing persistence of customer relationships rather than current customer count.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Customer cohort, eligible contract, gross/net retention, pause/reactivation, renewal period, product migration, first availability, revision and market denominator are not frozen.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: recall_safety_incident_enforcement_or_litigation_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A one-off adverse event stream relabeled as a recurring quality KPI.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Recall, safety, operational interruption, enforcement and litigation families are terminal or separately governed. Counting their events under a quality label does not create a new source state.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: quality_kpi_change_threshold_severity_peer_or_window_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A transformation of a quality or experience KPI over time, severity or peers.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing level versus change, threshold, severity, lag, seasonality, peer group, product subset or reporting window before base-source admission would multiply hypotheses and can exploit denominator changes.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_customer_experience_quality_retention_breadth_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Joint issuer exposure across returns, defects, complaints and retention outcomes.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted, denominator-sensitive and industry-heterogeneous families or selecting weights and models would expand the search before any component has a complete source contract.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four recurring customer/quality outcome states remain deferred at source admission; incident relabeling, premature transforms and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.

next_action: Record all seven decisions in the Campaign170 hash chain, publish terminal accounting, and continue a different finite offline prevalue domain.
